title: THE IN-RING INBOUND PROMPT STEPS ASIDE
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text never repeats what is already on screen. Standing in the ring he called, INBOUND and its seconds were printed over his own character while the band above the belt said EXTRACT A INBOUND with the same seconds. The prompt now steps aside while that ring is the one the band counts in, as the call and extract prompts already did. A ring that is not the active one keeps its prompt.
now: Standing in the ring you called, INBOUND shows once, in the band above the belt.
